import { Group, Mesh, PlaneGeometry, MeshStandardNodeMaterial } from 'three/webgpu';

// Sample: parallax-plane hero with depth displacement. renderMode='parallax-plane'.
// Generated per spec §9.C L340-L344 parallax-plane sub-prompt:
// tessellated 64x64 PlaneGeometry + TSL displacement node from depthMapUrl.

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const group = new Group();
  group.name = 'node:' + config.nodeId;
  group.userData.handlers = {};

  const geo = new PlaneGeometry(3.2, 1.8, 64, 64);
  const mat = new MeshStandardNodeMaterial();
  mat.map = ctx.textureLoader.loadTexture(config.imageUrl);
  mat.displacementMap = ctx.textureLoader.loadTexture(config.depthMapUrl);
  mat.displacementScale = 0.25;
  const mesh = new Mesh(geo, mat);
  group.add(mesh);

  for (const primitive of config.cinematicPrimitives ?? []) {
    ctx.primitives[primitive.name](group, primitive.params);
  }

  for (const text of config.textContent ?? []) {
    if (!text || !text.text) continue;
    const t = ctx.fontAtlas.createText({
      text: text.text,
      size: text.typography?.fontSize ?? 48,
    });
    group.add(t);
  }

  group.userData.cleanup = () => {
    geo.dispose();
    mat.dispose();
    if (mat.map && mat.map.dispose) mat.map.dispose();
    if (mat.displacementMap && mat.displacementMap.dispose) mat.displacementMap.dispose();
  };

  return group;
}
